summary: Improve dashboard interpretation, data-quality checks and evidence-based decisions. Explore practical data literacy training for non-technical managers.
lede: Data literacy training helps managers and analysts interpret reports and dashboards before using them to set priorities or explain decisions. Participants practise checking KPI definitions and data quality, spotting bias and limits in comparisons, and framing answerable questions. They also prepare concise decision briefs that connect evidence to recommendations, state caveats, and set out review plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for managers and analysts who use reports or dashboards to set priorities, monitor performance or explain decisions. It suits professionals who need to challenge the evidence constructively without building analytical models or writing code.
audience: Operations Managers using service and productivity dashboards
Change Managers using adoption and impact measures
prerequisites: Bring experience using workplace reports, performance measures or dashboards in a management or analytical role. No coding or specialist analytics software is required.
